instruction: Summarize all invoices by listing each invoice number and its total amount in a text file named 'invoice_summary.txt' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires reading all three invoice PDFs and extracting their invoice numbers and total amounts. Expected invoices are: (1) TII-20220301-90 with $8,480.00, (2) GES-20220215-82 with $3,180.00, (3) #243729 with $500.00. The evaluator checks if the text file contains all three invoice numbers and their corresponding amounts. Partial credit is given (0.33 per invoice found).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit: 0.33 for each invoice entry found (invoice number and amount both present). Full score (1.0) if all 3 invoice entries are found in the text file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts text file content from the specified path (/home/user/Desktop/invoice_summary.txt)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter (expected IS the rules dict when type="rule")
Metric logic correctly checks for both invoice number AND amount presence for each entry
Partial credit logic (found_count / total_entries) is appropriate for multi-item verification
Expected values are semantically correct: 3 invoices with correct numbers and amounts from the PDF files
Case-insensitive matching (result_lower) is appropriate for flexible text format verification
Evaluator covers all instruction requirements: verifies presence of all invoice numbers and their amounts
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding proximity checking to ensure invoice numbers and amounts appear near each other in the text, not just anywhere in the file
Minor: Consider adding validation that the text file exists before attempting to read it (handle file not found gracefully)
